guitar.modelsText: Custom "Arm the Homeless" guitar / Fender Telecaster "Soul Power"
guitar.notes: Tom Morello (also of Rage Against the Machine) is the guitarist for Audioslave; his heavily customized "Arm the Homeless" guitar and modified Telecaster are iconic and extremely well documented.

tone.target: thick stoner hard-rock crunch with fuzzy edge
tone.profile: thick stoner hard-rock crunch with fuzzy edge
tone.summary: A thick, fuzzy hard rock tone built around a high-gain preamp (UK 800 or Recti) combined with fuzz and a powerful 4x12 cabinet to achieve wide, dirty rhythm tones.

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and excessive noise inherent in high-gain stoner rock tones.
Provide a foundational mid-hump and slight grit boost to push the main distortion stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here as a general dirt/mid-boost, simulating an early drive pedal before the main fuzz/distortion. A dedicated Boost or OD 9 might be more direct but Green OD offers better grit for this style.

blocks.purpose: Introduce the required fuzzy texture and thick saturation characteristic of stoner rock.
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is chosen for its aggressive, saturated fuzz character, fulfilling the 'fuzzy edge' requirement. A dedicated Fuzz might be too extreme, while Distortion lacks enough grit.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the powerful, thick British high-gain tone (Marshall/Plexi family) needed for wide rhythm weight.
Provide the classic, powerful British cabinet sound required for thick hard rock punch.
Sculpt the tone by boosting low-mids and bass for 'fat low mids' while keeping the high end controlled.
Add subtle depth and space without creating 'big ambient' effects, maintaining a dry punch.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is used sparingly to add dimension without washing out the thick rhythm tone. A smaller plate or spring might be too bright/metallic.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and low-end punch by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive, thick stoner/hard rock focused model.

proposals.reason: Enhance low-end thickness and dirty punch for hard rock weight.
